summary: A throw from the for...of body closes the iterator while preserving the original throw precedence.

tests.name: throw closes iterator
tests.input: let closed=false; const it={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(){closed=true;return {done:true}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; try{for(const x of it){throw "x"}}catch{} console.log(closed);

tests.name: body throw wins over close throw
tests.input: const it={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(){throw "close"},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; try{for(const x of it){throw "body"}}catch(e){console.log(e)}
